name: azadi
description: Azadi Coffee Roastery — Telegram bot + admin panel

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
scripts.setup:webhook: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=$(grep '^TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=' ~/.env | cut -d= -f2-) SECRET_TOKEN=$(grep '^SECRET_TOKEN=' ~/.env | cut -d= -f2-) && [ -n "$TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN" ] && [ -n "$SECRET_TOKEN" ] && curl -s -X POST "https://api.telegram.org/bot${TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/setWebhook" -d "url=https://azadi-coffee-bot.zahedrastgar316.workers.dev/webhook&secret_token=${SECRET_TOKEN}" | python3 -m json.tool || { echo "Missing TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN or SECRET_TOKEN in ~/.env" >&2; exit 1; }
